d: Piazzetta di campagna, on one side home rustica di Rosa, and gate of the garden of Giannetta, on the other osteria of Agata, noble house of Don Marco, and workshop of Nunziella, in the background country view, with some mess. Rosa ahead his door working socks, Giannetta sitting ahead of the gate of his garden aglomite a net; Nunziella who accommodates the bread at the exhibition of his box office. Don Bucephalo eating the fried, and Agata, who is sewing; next to his osteria, young people serving on the table to Don Bucephalus.
Don Bucephalus, Rosa, and Agata.
Don Marco with his Jacket, then Don Bucephalus coming back.
Officer's carlino with mustache and sayings.
Agata, Giannetta, and Nunziella from their homes, then Don Bucephalus, from the door of Don Marco, followed by Giacchettito, who carries the cymbal on him, then Rosa.
Don Marco, and Carlino.
Said, Don Bucephalus, and Rosa from within; Agatha, and Giannetta from their homes.

Don Marco is then said Rosa, then Agata, and Carlino from opposite scenes.
Rustic room with barrels, and other utensils from villani. Doors 'side, and the cymbal in the middle. Rosa accommodating various things for the room then don Bucephalus.
Don Marco first inside then outside, and sayings.
